Position Summary
We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join Meridian Nexus, a fast-growing enterprise software company headquartered in Bengaluru. The Talent Acquisition Specialist will drive end-to-end recruitment for multiple engineering, product, and corporate functions, partnering closely with hiring managers, HRBP, and the wider People Operations team. This role will focus on delivering a best-in-class candidate experience, managing requisitions through to offer and onboarding, and leveraging our Workday system to maintain accurate hiring metrics and process compliance. This is a Hybrid role: Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end Recruitment Execution
- Manage full lifecycle recruitment for assigned roles including requisition intake, role scoping, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closure.
- Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurrent hiring needs and hard-to-fill technical roles.
- Ensure timely progression of candidates through the interview stages to meet time-to-hire targets.

Sourcing and Candidate Engagement
- Proactively source candidates using a mix of channels including job boards, networks, employee referrals, and targeted outreach.
- Conduct structured phone/virtual screens and assess candidate fit against role requirements and company culture.
- Represent Meridian Nexus at campus events, hiring fairs, and external employer branding activities as required.

Systems, Process and Compliance (Workday-focused)
- Own recruitment-related processes within Workday: create and manage requisitions, update candidate statuses, maintain interview feedback, and ensure data integrity.
- Partner with People Operations to implement and optimize recruitment workflows in Workday and ensure compliance with internal policies and legal requirements.
- Generate and present recruitment reports and dashboards from Workday to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management and Advisory
- Act as primary recruitment advisor to hiring managers: advise on role profiles, market hiring strategies, salary benchmarking, and selection decisions.
- Lead regular hiring reviews and provide status updates, risk assessments, and mitigation plans for open requisitions.
- Collaborate with HRBP and onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition of selected candidates into the organization.

Candidate Experience and Employer Brand
- Deliver a positive candidate experience across all touchpoints; ensure timely communication and feedback.
- Contribute to employer branding initiatives, social media outreach, and content that supports candidate attraction.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 2+ years experience in recruitment or talent acquisition roles, preferably within technology or high-growth companies.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Recruitment
- Talent Acquisition
- Workday

Other Required
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple reqs and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Attention to detail, especially with candidate data and recruitment metrics.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Payroll
- HRIS
- LinkedIn Recruiter
- Prior experience recruiting for engineering and product roles in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
- Familiarity with employment laws and hiring best practices in India.

Success Metrics
- Time-to-fill and time-to-offer for assigned requisitions against agreed SLAs.
- Offer acceptance rate and quality of hire (manager satisfaction and performance feedback at 3–6 months).
- Accuracy and completeness of recruitment data in Workday and regularity of stakeholder reporting.
- Candidate Net Promoter Score (candidate experience) for closed requisitions.
